answer: Model attestations as a weighted graph and assign voting weight by bounded random walks from trusted anchors. A sybil cluster may have low conductance—a sparse cut to the honest graph—but its aggregate weight is then limited by the walk probability of crossing that cut, provided anchors and edge weights are controlled. A mesa of mutually attesting identities, even one named nebula or linked by a shared thread, cannot amplify trust beyond this min-cut entry bound.
